summary: AVOKI IT AS (org. no. 983 591 744) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2001-08-23. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 62.200 (Konsulentvirksomhet tilknyttet informasjonsteknologi og forvaltning og drift av it-systemer); it has 21 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 83.9 m and net income was NOK 9.0 m. CEO: Tom Ekevall Larsen; board chair: Johan Erik Peter Uddfors; auditor: NITSCHKE AS.
